incident-bot: ALERT: Streaming tail p99 spike detected for /v1/stream (region: us-east-1 / ap-southeast-1). p99 > 2.5s for last 10m, errors rising. Auto-pager issued to oncall. :rotating_light:
ashwin: got the page, looking. seeing streaming stalls — a lot of streams hang around 30-60s then recover. p95 up ~1.1s, p99 ~3.2s.
maria-g: any deploys in the last hour?
deploy-bot: deploy event: convoys-service v2.14.0 rolled to us-east-1 @3087652000 by jenkins (canary succeeded).
jonathan: also seeing increased TLS handshake retries in the logs: many clients retransmitting SYN/ClientHello.
ashwin: pulling tcpdump from one afflicted node now.
ashwin: ```
15:22:18.123456 IP 10.0.4.12.54321 > 52.11.22.33.443: Flags [S], seq 12345, win 64240
15:22:18.123789 IP 52.11.22.33.443 > 10.0.4.12.54321: Flags [S.], seq 9999, ack 12346
15:22:18.223456 IP 10.0.4.12.54321 > 52.11.22.33.443: Flags [F.], seq 12346, ack 10000
```
ashwin: there's some reordering and retransmits, also out-of-order acks. suspect network path between AZB -> AZD via transit-gw.
maria-g: in metrics I see a spike in retransmits and path latency for hosts that egress via the transit gateway.
jonathan: checking conntrack / ephemeral port exhaustion on the nat instances: `sudo conntrack -S` shows conntrack table growing fast.
nashwin: `ss -s` shows many sockets in SYN-SENT and some in LAST-ACK.
sre-bot: runbook invoked: streaming-tail -> network-tier -> paging. Steps: 1) identify affected AZs 2) failover egress to alternate route 3) rollback recent deploy if needed.
ops-shift: routing teams — can we temporarily steer traffic off the transit-gw for the streaming fleet?
maria-g: we can tag the route table and shift prefix for service-convoy to the regional egress in us-east-1b. preparing a policy: `rtb-assoc replace`...
jonathan: running quick curl to health endpoint with --http2 and --no-keepalive to reproduce. `time curl -s -D- https://convoy.internal/v1/stream -o /dev/null` -> shows 2.8s at p99.
nashwin: also noticed DNS latency spikes for the streaming egress resolver — queries sometimes take 200-400ms. Could be the resolver path via transit-gw.
nashwin: tcpdump of DNS: many retransmitted queries to 169.254.x.y (resolver) with duplicated responses.
maria-g: ops-shift — I pushed a temporary route change to steer service-convoy egress to vpc-egress-2 in the same region. Can you confirm propagation?
ops-shift: saw route propagation ~30s ago, BGP flaps cleared. Monitoring now.
nashwin: after steering, tail latency dropped: p99 down to ~1.1s within 2m. Streaming stalls reduced.
nashwin: rolling mitigation: 1) keep steering for 30m, 2) add conntrack capacity and increase ephemeral port range on nat-efs as a safety net, 3) schedule deeper packet captures and collaboration with transit-gw infra.
jonathan: increasing conntrack max: `sysctl -w net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max=600000` and bumping `ip_local_port_range` to `15000 65535`. Applying to NAT autoscale group now.
maria-g: added temporary alert suppress for noisy TLS handshake retries for 15m while we stabilize.
sre-bot: note: customer-impact flag = partial degradation for streaming users in two regions; ticket created CID-2026-1184.
nashwin: action items: - ops to confirm route remains stable - infra to analyze transit-gw path and packet reordering - eng to review convoy v2.14.0 networking changes for keepalives/connection reuse - oncall to monitor SLOs and decide on rollback if regressions recur.
ops-shift: route steady for 18m, no additional flaps. conntrack bumped on 4 NAT hosts.
nashwin: collecting tcpdumps/pcaps for handoff to transit-gw team: `/var/log/pcaps/convoy-egress-3087654321.pcap`
jonathan: replicating load in staging with same egress path and convoys v2.14.0 to see if we can reproduce reordering.
maria-g: I'm preparing the post-incident note, will include timeline, mitigation, and follow-ups.
nashwin: leaving handoff: I'll be offline in 20m. @maria-g @jonathan please continue monitoring. If p99 creeps above 2s, escalate to SEV2 and consider rolling convoy back to v2.13.x. :thumbsup:
maria-g: ack. I'll keep the steering active for now and schedule a follow-up sync with transit infra in 2 hours.
incident-bot: INCIDENT: paging cleared (auto). Current status: mitigated (traffic steered). Persisting follow-ups assigned to networking and infra teams.
_meta: generated by dataset-generator: incident thread about streaming tail p99 spike, routing steering mitigation and on-call handoff
